authorization: User requested execution through e6; reuse existing infrastructure and subagent builders under parent supervision
cross_host_metric: per-host local windows plus separately named coordinator request through all-rank ready acknowledgment; never subtract cross-host monotonic clocks
preparation: bootstrap and owner/cache construction outside recovery windows; fresh IPC export inside coordinator request window, separately reported; model layout and transfer planning during restore remain in window
scope: existing eager initialized engines, immutable processed weight snapshots, fixed TP; no fresh-engine startup speedup claim

e1.criterion: correct generation in both fresh-export/import/release cycles and final physical/allocator/catalog recovery; preserve DRAM sources

e3.hypothesis: Equal total extra HBM with different placement changes selected sources and real readiness; report per-target regression and uncertainty
e3.warmup: 4MiB transfers on all relevant HBM source/target pairs before timed cases; setup reported separately

e4.hypothesis: Joint placement and routing outperform a strong feasible simple policy in actual readiness, not just predicted objective
e4.identical_decision_policy: Deduplicate identical physical layout and routing; record no policy increment, do not fabricate improvement
e4.profile: inherited provisional capacities with serial-target constraint; solver performance claims require hardware verification

e5.selection_rule: Use e4 observations to freeze strongest feasible simple routing and candidate; keep selection data distinct from confirmatory run
models: GLM TP16 representative case if capacity and valid baseline permit
e5.identical_decision_policy: No incremental algorithm claim; keep simpler policy and explicitly mark redundant comparison skipped

e6.purpose: Representative HBM-budget curve at a fixed complete DRAM base; not a full two-dimensional Pareto sweep
e6.gate: Correct comparable recovery and interpretable e5 outcome; if joint adds no value use selected simple policy and narrow algorithm claim; stop on correctness/budget violations

correctness: Full build SHA; each model restore generation matches frozen reference and full transfer SHA recorded with its actual validation time
resource_accounting: Complete DRAM base, extra HBM, target allocations, staging, initialized engine/KV, background owners; physical 1s monitor samples are sampled peaks, not exact high water
statistics: Exploratory single observations; second only for failure/uncertainty, no five-repeat sweep or stable-tail claim
failure_policy: Keep failed run directories; new run IDs for retries; never edit measured code while active
retained_state: CPU owners and valid source snapshots preserved; own model/cache resources are tracked explicitly
